title: Extension-field Wiedemann for low-cardinality minpoly
description:
Implement scalar Wiedemann over a degree-`k` extension `Fp

[x]/(f(x))` to close the low-cardinality minpoly cells where `q ≤ n` forces multi-seed Wiedemann (currently runs ~16 attempts × n³ matvecs and fails the 1.5x ceiling). ## Background `d1dd266c` landed packed Fp matvec + cubic cyclic-LCM minpoly fallback + multi-seed Wiedemann. Of the 8 minpoly target rows: - 5 PASS (GF(2^31-1)/64+256, GF(65521)/64+256, GF(7)/64). - 3 FAIL with multi-seed Wiedemann scaling: **GF(251)/n=256 (23.6x)**, **GF(7)/n=256 (2.06x)**. (GF(251)/n=64 minpoly fails for a different reason — panel-kernel overhead — handled by sibling task.) Per the binding plan `dev/active/d1dd266c-minpoly-sota-plan.md` § 4 escalation order, the next step before block Wiedemann is extension-field Wiedemann: 1. Embed the base-field matrix in `Fp

[x]/(f(x))` with `q^k > n`. 2. Run scalar Wiedemann over the extension (where the q > n gate is satisfied — single Wiedemann pass, not multi-seed). 3. Verify the result descends to base-field coefficients and annihilates the original matrix over the base field. ## Hard ceilings (fflas-ffpack reference) | Cell | fflas wall | 1.5x ceiling | Current gf2 wall | Current ratio | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | GF(251)/n=256 minpoly | 1.634 ms | 2.451 ms | 38.5 ms | 23.6x FAIL | | GF(7)/n=256 minpoly | 20.290 ms | 30.435 ms | 41.7 ms | 2.06x FAIL | ## Success Criteria - [hard] Extension-field Wiedemann is engaged from `minpoly_dispatch` for `Fp

` whenever `q ≤ n` and `q^k > n` for the chosen extension degree `k`. The previous `multi_seed_wiedemann_minpoly` path is retained as a fallback only when extension-field Wiedemann cannot construct a usable extension. - [hard] Both target rows above meet the 1.5x ceiling on the current Zen 3 host with the production dispatch. - [hard] Correctness: the returned polynomial annihilates `A` over the base field, divides `charpoly(A)`, and matches the existing `cyclic_decomposition` LCM reference for adversarial Jordan-block + randomized small-matrix tests over `Fp<7>` and `Fp<251>`. - [hard] Coefficient-descent step is verified by a per-call check that the extension polynomial has all coefficients in the base field; if the descent fails, fall back to the existing multi-seed path. - [hard] Final evidence updates `dev/bench_results/2026-05-07-d1dd266c-minpoly-tuning.md` (or a successor doc) with raw Criterion medians for the two target cells, recording the algorithm class as "extension-field Wiedemann (degree k=...)" per row. ## Notes The plan's § 5 escalation to block Wiedemann is reserved for the case where extension-field Wiedemann cannot meet correctness or wall-time targets. Block Wiedemann is significantly more involved (Coppersmith / Villard) and out of scope for this task. This task plus its sibling tasks (panel-kernel inline + canonical-byte polynomial arithmetic) collectively close the four residual `d1dd266c` cells. `d1dd266c` is blocked on all three siblings.
